stem.text: The graph shows the effect of different partial pressures of carbon dioxide ($\text{CO}_2$) on the oxygen dissociation curve for haemoglobin.

stem.alt: Graph of percentage saturation of haemoglobin with oxygen against partial pressure of oxygen in kPa, with two curves labelled partial pressure CO2 1.0 kPa and partial pressure CO2 1.5 kPa

stem.text: What is the change in percentage oxygen saturation of haemoglobin at a partial pressure of oxygen of $6\,\text{kPa}$ as the partial pressure of carbon dioxide changes from $1.0\,\text{kPa}$ to $1.5\,\text{kPa}$?
